annotations.title: Generate GovCon 30/60/90-Day Phase-In / Phase-Out Transition & Incumbent Capture Plan

description: Generate a risk-mitigated 30/60/90-Day Phase-In and Phase-Out Transition Plan from solicitation Section C/L/M transition instructions and incumbent workforce context, returning a 0-100 Transition Risk Readiness Score, an executive transition summary, chronological Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) milestones across Days 1-30, 31-60, and 61-90 (plus Phase-Out), an Executive Order 14055 / Service Contract Act (SCA) Incumbent Workforce Capture & Right-of-First-Refusal retention plan with DD-254/DISS clearance crossover timelines and outreach scripts, functional Knowledge Transfer & Shadowing tracks with COR Operational Readiness Review (ORR) gates, a FAR 52.237-3 Continuity of Services Phase-Out checklist, and a ready-to-submit Shipley Transition Plan proposal volume. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive capture and program-management generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `solicitation_transition_and_sow_text` accepts 30 to 75,000 characters, optional `incumbent_workforce_and_clearance_context` accepts up to 50,000 characters, and `transition_timeline_window` calibrates milestone cadences across 30-day rapid cutovers, standard 30/60/90-day transitions, 120-day enterprise transitions, and FAR 52.237-3 phase-outs). Use this tool when drafting a Phase-In / Phase-Out Transition Plan volume, WBS mobilization schedule, or incumbent staff capture strategy; use `match_key_personnel` instead to audit and format individual Key Personnel resumes and Letters of Commitment, or `generate_teaming_strategy` for 13 CFR 125.6 Prime/Sub workshare splits.

clearance_requirement.default: Secret / Top Secret SCI & Public Trust
clearance_requirement.description: Optional personnel and facility security clearance level required (DD-254 / DISS / Public Trust).

incumbent_workforce_and_clearance_contex.description: Optional incumbent contractor details, target FTE count, Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) / Service Contract Act (SCA) context, and DD-254 facility/personnel security clearance transfer requirements (0 to 50,000 characters).

solicitation_transition_and_sow_text.description: Solicitation Section C/L/M transition instructions, PWS scope, incumbent staffing size, clearance levels, and continuity-of-operations mandates (30 to 75,000 characters).

target_agency.default: Department of Defense (DoD) / Federal & State Agency
target_agency.description: Optional issuing agency or contracting office.

transition_duration_days.description: Optional total Phase-In transition duration in calendar days (15 to 180; defaults to 90).

name: generate_phase_in_transition_plan

executive_transition_summary.description: Executive summary of the zero-mission-disruption Phase-In / Phase-Out strategy, governance structure, and Day-1 Full Operational Capability (FOC) roadmap.

far_52_237_3_phase_out_continuity_checkl.description: FAR 52.237-3 Continuity of Services Phase-Out checklist covering GFE/GFP return, CUI sanitization, credential revocation, and successor contractor training.

incumbent_capture_and_retention_plan.description: Comprehensive incumbent workforce capture, EO 14055 / SCA right-of-first-refusal compliance, DD-254/DISS clearance crossover timeline, and outreach script.

knowledge_transfer_and_shadowing_schedul.description: Functional knowledge transfer tracks with side-by-side shadowing durations, artifact handover checklists, and COR Operational Readiness Review (ORR) gates.

ready_to_submit_transition_volume.description: Complete, paste-ready Shipley Phase-In / Phase-Out Transition Plan proposal volume narrative in Markdown.

transition_risk_readiness_score.description: 0-100 score quantifying Day-1 operational continuity, incumbent capture probability, and FAR 52.237-3 compliance readiness.

wbs_30_60_90_day_milestones.description: Chronological Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) transition milestones across Days 1-30, Days 31-60, Days 61-90 (and Phase-Out) with activities, deliverables, exit criteria, and risk mitigations.

title: Generate GovCon 30/60/90-Day Phase-In / Phase-Out Transition & Incumbent Capture Plan
